rss_feeds.name: Hacker News Show HN (New FOSS Projects)

curated_records.source_title: Coolify: The Self-Hosted Vercel and Heroku Alternative
curated_records.excerpt: Coolify is an open-source & self-hostable all-in-one PaaS that replaces Vercel, Netlify, and Heroku. It deploys Next.js, Docker, databases, and cron jobs directly onto your own $5/month Hetzner or DigitalOcean VPS with zero vendor lock-in.

curated_records.source_title: n8n: Self-Hosted Fair-Code Workflow Automation Replacing Zapier
curated_records.excerpt: While Zapier charges $59/mo for basic multi-step tasks, self-hosted n8n handles unlimited workflow executions, custom JavaScript/Python execution, AI agent tool calling, and 400+ API integrations on a single docker-compose container for $0 compute cost.

curated_records.source_title: Documenso: The Open Source DocuSign Alternative
curated_records.excerpt: DocuSign enterprise plans cost $40 per user per month. Documenso is an open-source signing platform built with Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL that gives you cryptographic signing, audit trails, and self-hosted control.

curated_records.source_title: Open-WebUI: The User-Friendly Self-Hosted AI Interface
curated_records.excerpt: Gaining over 75k GitHub stars, Open-WebUI provides a ChatGPT-equivalent experience running 100% locally or self-hosted. Features include Ollama integration, document RAG, voice calls, custom prompt pipelines, and multi-user RBAC.

curated_records.source_title: LiteLLM: 100+ LLMs Behind a Single OpenAI-Compatible Proxy
curated_records.excerpt: LiteLLM standardizes calls to Bedrock, Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, and Ollama into OpenAI format with automatic failover, load balancing, budget tracking, and spend guardrails in production.

curated_records.source_title: Stirling-PDF: 100% Local Powerful PDF Manipulation Suite
curated_records.excerpt: Stop uploading sensitive contracts to random freemium PDF sites. Stirling-PDF runs locally via Docker, offering OCR, PDF splitting, merging, redaction, compression, and signature verification with zero telemetry.

curated_records.source_title: Ollama: Run DeepSeek, Llama 3, and Mistral Locally in 1 Command
curated_records.excerpt: Ollama packages open-weight model weights, quantization configs, and GPU acceleration into a single CLI tool. Run SOTA 8B and 14B reasoning models on your MacBook or Linux machine with sub-second token latency.

curated_records.source_title: vLLM: High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient LLM Serving
curated_records.excerpt: By introducing PagedAttention for KV cache management, vLLM delivers 24x higher throughput than HuggingFace Transformers. It has become the industry standard for self-hosting high-concurrency LLM inference on private GPU clusters.

curated_records.source_title: LazyGit: Simple Terminal UI for Git Commands
curated_records.excerpt: LazyGit turns complex interactive rebasing, hunk staging, and merge conflict resolution into instant single-keystroke operations in the terminal. Used by thousands of engineers to eliminate GUI git bloat.

curated_records.source_title: Ripgrep: Ultra-Fast Text Search Outperforming GNU Grep
curated_records.excerpt: Written in Rust, ripgrep recursively searches directories for regex patterns while automatically respecting .gitignore rules and skipping binary files. Benchmarks show it searching 100k+ file repositories in under 200ms.

curated_records.source_title: Caddy 2: Automatic HTTPS and Reverse Proxy with 3-Line Config
curated_records.excerpt: Say goodbye to complex NGINX certbot renew cron jobs. Caddy obtains and renews Let's Encrypt TLS certificates automatically by default and proxies requests with memory-safe Go architecture.

curated_records.source_title: PocketBase: Open Source Backend in 1 Single File with Embedded SQLite
curated_records.excerpt: PocketBase bundles realtime database, auth, file storage, and an admin UI into a single standalone binary. Perfect for SaaS MVPs and internal tools that need production persistence on $4/month hardware.

curated_records.source_title: The Open Source Bait-and-Switch: Why Startups Relicense from MIT to BSL
curated_records.excerpt: Analyzing the economic transition of Redis, Terraform, and Elastic. When VC-funded open source companies face cloud provider competition, they abandon permissive licenses. Why true community-governed FOSS (AGPL/Linux Foundation) survives.

curated_records.source_title: The Hidden Costs of Self-Hosting: When Paying for SaaS Actually Makes Sense
curated_records.excerpt: Self-hosting is free in software licenses, but costs engineer hours in backups, patching, security audits, and failover. A practitioner framework for calculating when to self-host vs when your time is worth more than a $20/month SaaS invoice.

curated_records.source_title: The Reverse-Engineering System Prompt: Extracting Code, Architecture & API Contracts from Any URL
curated_records.excerpt: A battle-tested 40-line system prompt code that instructs ChatGPT/Claude to parse any raw HTML, CSS, or network trace into a complete database schema, component hierarchy, and API contract with zero filler words.

curated_records.source_title: The Chain-of-Density Prompt: How to Condense 10,000-Word Docs into 5 Dense Insights
curated_records.excerpt: Based on Columbia/Salesforce research: a prompt code that iteratively compresses text over 5 passes without losing critical entities or numbers. Increases information density by 400% compared to standard ChatGPT summarization.

curated_records.source_title: The Tree-of-Thoughts Megaprompt: Eliminating Code Bugs and Logic Flaws with 3 Autonomous Personas
curated_records.excerpt: Forces ChatGPT to branch into 3 independent adversarial reviewers (Architect, Security Auditor, Performance Engineer), debate each solution, and return the provably optimal implementation.

curated_records.source_title: The Zero-Hallucination SQL Generator: Prompt Code That Never Invents Column Names
curated_records.excerpt: A schema-constrained prompt pattern that enforces strict AST validation and schema bounds. Guaranteed to fail closed with explanatory error rather than inventing fake tables.

curated_records.source_title: The Deep-Research Autonomous Agent Prompt: Turning ChatGPT into a 24/7 Market Intelligence Bot
curated_records.excerpt: A 5-phase iterative search prompt that breaks broad industry questions into search matrices, conducts source triangulation, and outputs a 10-point actionable executive briefing.

curated_records.source_title: Skeleton-of-Thought (SoT): The Secret Prompt Framework That Accelerates LLMs by 4x
curated_records.excerpt: Based on UC Berkeley research: decouples generation into a skeleton blueprint followed by parallel point expansion. Eliminates token generation bottlenecks and slashes response latency by 2.5x to 4x.

curated_records.source_title: The AppSec Red-Team Megaprompt: Scanning Pull Requests for 0-Day Flaws and SQLi in 10 Seconds
curated_records.excerpt: Simulates an offensive application security auditor scanning code for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, unauthenticated IDORs, and SSRF flaws with exploit PoCs and hardened code patches.

curated_records.source_title: Uptime Kuma: High-Performance Self-Hosted Monitoring Replacing Datadog
curated_records.excerpt: Say goodbye to $200/mo Pingdom and Datadog bills. Uptime Kuma monitors HTTP, TCP, DNS, and Docker containers with beautiful real-time status pages and Telegram/Discord alerts on a 50MB RAM footprint.

curated_records.source_title: SearXNG: Private Self-Hosted Metasearch Without Google Tracking
curated_records.excerpt: Aggregates search results from 70+ search engines while stripping all user tracking, profiling, and telemetry. Host your own private search engine with a single Docker container.

curated_records.source_title: Authentik: Open Source Identity Provider & SSO Replacing Auth0
curated_records.excerpt: Auth0 charges hundreds per month once you exceed basic tiers. Authentik delivers SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, and multi-factor auth across all your private servers and SaaS apps with zero per-user fees.

curated_records.source_title: PostHog: Open Source Product Analytics and Feature Flags
curated_records.excerpt: Replaces Mixpanel, LaunchDarkly, and Hotjar in one self-hosted platform. Full event ingestion, session replay, heatmaps, and AB testing on your own infrastructure with total GDPR compliance.

curated_records.source_title: Vaultwarden: Lightweight Bitwarden Password Manager for Self-Hosting
curated_records.excerpt: Written in Rust, Vaultwarden implements the full Bitwarden API in under 20MB of RAM. Store enterprise team credentials, 2FA tokens, and secure notes with zero monthly cloud subscriptions.

curated_records.source_title: RustDesk: Open Source Remote Desktop Replacing TeamViewer and AnyDesk
curated_records.excerpt: Commercial remote desktop licenses cost $50/seat/mo and cut connections mid-session. RustDesk lets you establish peer-to-peer encrypted remote desktop connections on your own relay server.

curated_records.source_title: Immich: Self-Hosted High-Performance Photo Backup Replacing Google Photos
curated_records.excerpt: Google Photos charges $10/mo for 2TB cloud storage. Immich offers lightning-fast mobile backup, facial recognition, vector search, and RAW photo processing on your local home server.

curated_records.source_title: AppFlowy: Open Source Notion Alternative with Local Data Privacy
curated_records.excerpt: Built with Flutter and Rust, AppFlowy gives teams Notion-style wikis, Kanban boards, and database tables with 100% offline data sovereignty and zero vendor lock-in.

curated_records.source_title: Cal.com: Open Source Scheduling Infrastructure Replacing Calendly
curated_records.excerpt: Calendly charges $16/user/month for basic routing and custom branding. Cal.com is an open-source scheduling engine with calendar sync, webhooks, and team routing running on Next.js.

curated_records.source_title: Plane: Open Source Project Management Tool Replacing Jira and Linear
curated_records.excerpt: Linear and Jira charge per-seat SaaS bills that compound rapidly. Plane provides issue tracking, cycles, modules, and roadmaps with a modern dark-mode interface self-hosted via Docker.

curated_records.source_title: Penpot: Open Source Design & Prototyping Platform Replacing Figma
curated_records.excerpt: Adobe and Figma lock UI designers into proprietary cloud formats. Penpot runs on open web standards (SVG, CSS Grid, Flexbox) natively in the browser and self-hosts on private hardware.

curated_records.source_title: Supabase: Open Source Firebase Alternative with Postgres, Auth, and Storage
curated_records.excerpt: Over 75k GitHub stars: Supabase provides a production Postgres database, Row Level Security, instant REST & GraphQL APIs, realtime subscriptions, and auth running on docker compose for $0.

curated_records.source_title: Meilisearch: Lightning Fast Open Source Search Engine Outperforming Algolia
curated_records.excerpt: Algolia's search usage billing spikes unexpectedly. Meilisearch is a Rust-powered typo-tolerant search engine providing sub-50ms search-as-you-type responses with zero setup friction.

curated_records.source_title: Paperless-ngx: Open Source Document Archiving with Automatic OCR
curated_records.excerpt: Scan invoices, contracts, and receipts into a single self-hosted document vault with automatic machine-learning categorization, full-text search, and tagging on local hardware.

curated_records.source_title: Hoppscotch: Open Source Lightweight API Client Replacing Postman
curated_records.excerpt: Postman forced mandatory cloud accounts and broke offline workflows. Hoppscotch is a 100% open source, lightweight web and desktop API testing ecosystem with zero cloud telemetry.

curated_records.source_title: NocoDB: Open Source Smart Spreadsheet Database Replacing Airtable
curated_records.excerpt: Airtable's strict row limits and $20/user pricing hinder growing startups. NocoDB turns any existing MySQL or PostgreSQL database into a collaborative smart spreadsheet with unlimited rows.

curated_records.source_title: Twenty: Modern Open Source CRM Replacing Salesforce and HubSpot
curated_records.excerpt: Salesforce and HubSpot charge thousands in annual contracts. Twenty is an AGPL-licensed, self-hosted CRM built with TypeScript and PostgreSQL that puts contact data under your direct ownership.

curated_records.source_title: Portainer: Lightweight Container Management Web UI for Docker
curated_records.excerpt: Manage Docker containers, images, networks, volumes, and stacks across home labs and cloud VPS instances through an intuitive visual dashboard with 1-click redeployments.

curated_records.source_title: Grafana: Open Source Observability & Metric Visualization Dashboards
curated_records.excerpt: Visualize Prometheus metrics, Postgres queries, and server telemetry in high-performance dashboards without paying $15/host SaaS monitoring premiums.

curated_records.source_title: Affine: Open Source Next-Gen Collaborative Workspace Unifying Docs and Whiteboards
curated_records.excerpt: Unifies Notion, Miro, and Monday into a single privacy-first canvas. Switch effortlessly between structured documents and infinite spatial whiteboard diagrams on local hardware.
